Self-update: a Windows helper that works without a console, clearer labels

The update offered "version 1.0.0" because only the build number
changes, and on Windows the new version did not start. The helper now
waits until the folder can be renamed instead of using tasklist and
timeout (which does not wait without a console), gets its paths through
environment variables, runs without a window with its streams redirected
and logs to %TEMP%. The menu names builds. The swap and restart test runs
on Windows, Linux and macOS in every build.
